data.narrative:
Focused Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Thomas Forner and Markus Roth that has raised $240M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 comparable companies—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private entities across the nuclear energy sector, including Valar Atomics, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, Helion, and X-Energy.

Two triangulation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $240M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying a valuation of $480M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $808M, though the peer set spans a wide range from $200M (Fuse Energy at Series A) to $6.0B (Valar Atomics at Series B), with Nano Nuclear Energy valued at $808M at Seed stage.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $408M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $644M. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of stage-progression assumptions given the wide dispersion in peer valuations and the influence of later-stage outliers (Valar Atomics at $6.0B) on peer positioning. The $236M spread between low and high estimates reflects meaningful variance in how nuclear frontier-tech venture stage transitions are priced in the current market.
